Blockquote

A quotation set apart from the text (Mantine's Blockquote): a colored edge, a quote mark on it and the attribution below. A real <blockquote> inside, with the source's URL as its cite.

Default
The most dangerous phrase in the language is "We've always done it this way."
Variants and colors
Simplicity is prerequisite for reliability. The best way to predict the future is to invent it. The more I study, the more insatiable do I feel my genius for it to be. A closure stored in a variable cannot cross a fiber boundary in a native build.
Spacing and edge
Compact, for dense panels and sidebars. Roomy, for a quote that leads a section. Only the tint and the mark, no colored edge. The plainest one: a bordered box.
A testimonial

We moved our desktop tools to raylang and ray-ds in a week. The components looked right on day one, in light and dark, and the forms just worked.

Katherine JohnsonEngineering lead, Orbit Labs
Verified customer
In an article

Why the web components are form-associated

Every field of ray-ds takes part in its <form> like a native control: it is submitted under its name, validated, reset and disabled by a fieldset.

Form-associated custom elements enable web authors to define and create custom elements which participate in form submission.

That is why a FormData built from a form full of ray-ds fields has every value in it, with no glue code.

API

<ray-blockquote> · RayBlockquote

Paragraphs in it are spaced and the last one has no bottom margin. The attribution is text (cite) or rich content (slot="cite": an avatar, a name, a role).

PropertyAttributeTypeDefaultDescription
citecitestringWho said it, shown below the quote ("— Grace Hopper").
hrefhrefstringURL of the source: the inner blockquote's cite attribute.
colorcolor reflectsstringA palette color or any CSS color, for the edge, the mark and the tint. Default: the primary.
variantvariant reflectslight | outline | filledlightlight: tinted background; outline: border and edge only; filled: solid color (a pull quote).
iconiconstringquoteRegistry icon of the mark, or none. The icon slot replaces it.
sizesize reflectssm | md | lgmdText size (lg for a pull quote).
paddingpadding reflectsstringInner spacing: xs…xl (the spacing scale), px as a number, or a CSS length. Default: md.
hideEdgehide-edge reflectsbooleanNo colored edge on the start side (the tint, border and mark stay).
radiusradius reflectsstringCorner radius: xs…xl, none, or a CSS length. Default: md.
SlotDescription
(default)The quotation (text or paragraphs).
citeRich attribution, instead of cite.
iconA custom mark, instead of icon.
PartDescription
quoteThe <blockquote>.
iconThe disc with the mark.
citeThe attribution (a <figcaption>).
